name: SpaceX / xAI (merged)
monetization: Grok subscriptions/API and X platform integration inside SpaceX's launch/Starlink cash-flow machine; monetizes the merger thesis that space and AI compute converge.
description_md: This record covers the merged xAI/SpaceX entity: SpaceX absorbed xAI in an all-stock deal on Feb 2, 2026 at a combined ~$1.25T valuation ($1T SpaceX / $250B xAI), with xAI operating as a wholly owned subsidiary — the largest private merger ever. The combined company then completed the largest IPO in history (Nasdaq: SPCX, June 12, 2026, ~$75B raised at ~$1.8T, closing day one near $2.1T). xAI builds the Grok models and runs the Colossus campus in Memphis, one of the largest single AI training sites in the world.
ai_monetization_md: AI revenue is currently small relative to the merged entity's launch and Starlink businesses: Grok subscriptions (standalone and via X), API access, and enterprise/sovereign deals (Humain's Saudi 500MW JV has xAI as anchor tenant, alongside Humain's $3B investment). The monetization bet is longer-dated: Musk frames orbital data centers as the eventual cheapest way to run large-scale AI compute, making Starlink/Starship the distribution and logistics layer for AI. The agreed $60B all-stock acquisition of Anysphere (Cursor) — pending close, expected Q3 2026 — would add one of the fastest-growing AI software revenue streams (~$4B ARR) to the group.
ai_strategy_md: Vertical integration at Musk scale: build frontier compute in-house (Colossus/Colossus 2 in Memphis, financed partly off balance sheet via a ~$20B GPU-leasing SPV — Valor equity anchor, Nvidia ≤$2B, ~$12.5B debt led by Apollo/Diameter, with the SPV buying Nvidia GPUs and leasing them to xAI over five years), secure power through the Solaris Energy JV (>1.1GW of turbines by 2027), raise huge private capital ($20B Series E at $230B, Jan 2026: Nvidia, Cisco, Valor, Fidelity, QIA, MGX, Humain), then use the merger + IPO to give the AI buildout a public currency — immediately deployed on the agreed $60B Cursor acquisition.
risk_notes_md: Key-man concentration on Musk across four ventures; the GPU SPV moves ~$20B of depreciating GPU assets and lease obligations off xAI's balance sheet while lenders' recourse is the hardware itself (a canonical compute-as-collateral structure); Nvidia sits on both sides (SPV equity and GPU supplier). Grok revenue remains unproven relative to the ~$250B AI-side valuation embedded at merger; the Cursor deal is stock-funded and not yet closed; the space-compute thesis is untested economics.

observations.notes: xAI standalone: $20B Series E (upsized from $15B) at $230B, Jan 2026. Investors incl. Nvidia, Cisco Investments, Valor, Fidelity, QIA, MGX, StepStone, Baron; Humain invested $3B. Superseded by the Feb 2026 merger.
